text: {"summary": "The call was to confirm the EMI status. The customer acknowledged the pending EMI of 4500 rupees due on the 5th and committed to paying by the 28th due to a salary delay. The agent noted the commitment and will monitor for payment by the 28th.","key_points": ["EMI amount of 4500 rupees was due on the 5th; the payment is currently pending.","Customer Rahul stated his salary was late and he will pay by the 28th.","Agent acknowledged the commitment and will note the payment by the 28th."],"action_items": ["Customer to make the EMI payment of 4500 rupees by the 28th.","Agent to note the promised payment date and monitor for receipt by the 28th."],"classification": "PROMISE_TO_PAY"}

{"summary": "The customer claims to have paid the EMI via UPI yesterday and provided a transaction ID (T2409). The agent will verify the payment and update the account accordingly.","key_points": ["Customer states they paid the EMI via UPI yesterday and has a screenshot.","Customer provided the transaction ID: T2409.","Agent will check the payment and update the account."],"action_items": ["Verify the UPI payment using the provided transaction ID (T2409).","Update the EMI status in the system once payment is confirmed.","Send confirmation to the customer after verification."],"classification": "ALREADY_PAID"}

{"summary": "The customer refused to pay the overdue loan and raised a product defect complaint. The agent acknowledged the loan is separate from the product issue and escalated the complaint, while the customer requested no further calls.","key_points": ["Overdue loan amount is 12,000 rupees.","Customer states they are not paying and mentions a product defect; claims nobody helped.","Agent states the loan is separate from the product issue.","Customer requests not to be called again.","Agent will escalate the complaint."],"action_items": ["Escalate the customer's complaint to the appropriate department.","Update CRM with the customer's refusal to pay and the product defect complaint.","Do not initiate further calls to this customer unless requested."],"classification": "CALLBACK_REQUESTED"}

{"summary": "The customer requested a callback at 6 PM due to being busy; the agent agreed to call back at that time.","key_points": ["Customer is currently driving and unavailable to talk.","Customer requested a callback at 6 PM.","Agent confirmed to call back at 6 PM."],"action_items": ["Place a callback to the customer at 6 PM."],"classification": "CALLBACK_REQUESTED"}

{"summary": "The caller attempted to reach Sunita Sharma but the number is not associated with that name. The caller requests updating the records to reflect the correct contact information and to prevent future misdials.","key_points": ["Caller states they are not Sunita Sharma and that this is the wrong number.","Caller mentions their number has been in records for three years and asks to update the records.","Caller requests that the records be updated to reflect the correct contact information."],"action_items": ["Update the records to reflect the correct contact name (not Sunita Sharma) and the correct phone number.","Ensure future calls are directed to the correct number and update CRM/records accordingly."],"classification": "WRONG_NUMBER"}

{"summary": "The agent attempted to reach the customer, but the call did not connect. The agent will retry the call later.","key_points": ["Agent attempted to connect with the customer but the call did not connect.","Agent stated they would try again later."],"action_items": ["Retry the call to the customer at a later time."],"classification": "NO_RESPONSE"}
